purpose: Illustrative decision-test vignettes for the terminal outside-taxonomy outcome (including deliberately out-of-scope narratives). Not part of N=11. Not empirical validation evidence. Not ticket extracts.

vignettes.narrative: Login fails after IdP success when the RP clock is skewed past assertion NotOnOrAfter / token exp during a JWKS rollover window.
vignettes.rationale: Clock/JWKS adjacent surfaces; no Table IV inclusion rule is primary.

vignettes.narrative: Same cohort sees both WAN LDAP bind timeouts and gateway rejection of large SAML POSTs in one outage window.
vignettes.rationale: Multi-causal: directory_federation and protocol_gateway remain equally plausible after tie-breakers.

vignettes.narrative: Browser Intelligent Tracking Prevention drops the edge callback cookie mid-flow; IdP logs show success.
vignettes.rationale: ITP/captive-portal-class client isolation is adjacent, not an inclusion cell.

vignettes.narrative: Authorization server rejects the token request for PKCE code_verifier mismatch; edge never receives a callback capability.
vignettes.rationale: AS-side PKCE failure is not edge_callback_consume and has no other Table IV home.

vignettes.narrative: Warm SSO is treated as sufficient to skip edge re-authorization after network ACL revoke (no callback race).
vignettes.rationale: Tie-breaker favors nested session planes over edge_side_effect when release was never attempted.

vignettes.narrative: After site-level load-balancer failover, users land on a cold node in the secondary site. The browser still carries an SSO cookie but application session attributes are missing until full re-login. No divergent authentication outcomes across nodes within the same IdP cluster are reported.
vignettes.rationale: Cross-site stickiness and session visibility loss after failover; cluster_state applies only when in-cluster cache split is affirmed after affinity is ruled out.

vignettes.narrative: Identity login succeeds and the first edge callback returns HTTP 200, but downstream firewall sync fails and network access is unchanged. The operator retries with the same callback URL; the edge endpoint accepts the second presentation because it checks capability presence only and does not atomically consume.
vignettes.rationale: Consume-defect tie-breaker: single-use lifecycle failure when a second presentation is accepted without atomic consumption.

vignettes.narrative: Users authenticating through the secondary IdP receive group memberships as opaque binary attribute values while the primary IdP emits the same LDAP groups as string security identifiers; application authorization fails intermittently. Packet capture shows intact SAML POST size with no reported middlebox truncation.
vignettes.rationale: Shared directory with divergent token or claim semantics across co-deployed IdPs; no affirmative gateway payload damage before IdP logic.
